name: Exp_Beginner
summary: This EA uses the custom 'Beginner' indicator to generate buy and sell signals based on momentum reversals detected by the indicator's buffer values. It opens and closes positions based on these signals, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The EA operates on a specified timeframe and includes new bar detection to avoid redundant signal processing.
summary_zh: 该EA使用自定义'Beginner'指标根据动量反转信号进行买卖操作。基于指标缓冲区值生成入场和出场信号，支持可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈。EA在指定时间周期上运行，并包含新K线检测以避免重复信号处理。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Beginner自定义指标识别动量反转点，当指标上轨缓冲区(缓冲区1)出现非零非空值时产生买入信号，当下轨缓冲区(缓冲区0)出现非零非空值时产生卖出信号。入场条件为：在指定信号K线(SignalBar)上检测到Beginner指标的上轨或下轨信号值，配合BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen开关控制方向权限。出场条件包括止损和止盈的固定点数设置，以及当检测到反向信号时平仓（买入信号触发空头平仓，卖出信号触发多头平仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化函数，支持偏差控制和信号时间过滤。策略还包含一个回溯搜索机制，当没有直接反向平仓信号时，会遍历历史K线寻找最近的反向信号以确定持仓方向。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Beginner custom indicator which identifies momentum reversal points; when the upper buffer (buffer 1) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE, a buy signal is generated, and when the lower buffer (buffer 0) shows a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE, a sell signal is generated. Entry conditions require detecting the Beginner indicator signal values on the specified signal bar (SignalBar), with BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen toggles controlling directional permission. Exit conditions include fixed-point stop loss and take profit settings, as well as closing positions when opposite signals are detected (buy signals trigger short position closure, sell signals trigger long position closure). Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-proportional sizing. Money management utilizes standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, supporting deviation control and signal time filtering. The strategy also incorporates a lookback search mechanism that traverses historical bars to find the most recent opposite signal for determining position direction when no direct opposite closure signal exists on the current bar.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 信号处理采用新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线上重复交易
提供完整的买卖方向开关控制，灵活性高
包含止损和止盈保护，风险可控
使用Recount机制在数据复制失败时自动重试，增强鲁棒性
支持按存款比例或固定手数两种仓位管理模式
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents redundant trades on the same bar
Full directional toggle controls for buy/sell open and close provide high flexibility
Stop loss and take profit protections are included for risk control
Recount mechanism automatically retries on data copy failure, enhancing robustness
Supports both deposit-proportional and fixed lot position sizing modes
cons: 依赖自定义Beginner指标，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
回溯搜索历史K线寻找反向信号的循环没有上限限制，可能导致性能问题
缺少点差过滤和交易时段过滤，在高点差时段可能造成不必要的损失
止损和止盈使用固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR）动态调整
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Depends on the custom Beginner indicator whose logic is opaque, making signal validity hard to verify
The lookback loop searching historical bars for opposite signals has no upper bound, potentially causing performance issues
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may cause unnecessary losses during high-spread periods
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for market volatility
No position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 添加点差过滤和交易时段限制，避免高点差和低流动性时段交易
将历史K线回溯搜索添加最大迭代次数限制，防止性能瓶颈
使用ATR动态调整止损止盈，适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session restrictions to avoid trading during high-spread and low-liquidity periods
Add a maximum iteration limit to the historical bar lookback search to prevent performance bottlenecks
Use ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt to different market volatility environments

risk_points: 回溯搜索历史K线没有循环上限，在数据量很大时可能导致EA卡顿或超时
缺少持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，增加风险敞口
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动变化，极端行情下保护可能不足
risk_points_en: The lookback search loop has no iteration limit, which may cause EA lag or timeout with large data sets
Lack of position checks may lead to duplicate openings in the same direction, increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to market volatility changes, potentially providing insufficient protection during extreme moves
